arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog has been growing all week. I recommend investigating why jobs are failing and exporting the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Additionally, I suggest checking the pgbouncer logs for any issues related to timeouts, which could indicate a full disk. Restarting services in the prod namespace should be done with my explicit permission.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate and address the root cause of the failing jobs, export the failed_jobs table, and monitor pgbouncer logs for disk full issues.
